tools.description: Runs Iron Canyon Co's Website Punch List on a contractor's website. tools.name: describe_website_punch_list
tools.description: Returns the fixed list of what Iron Canyon Co's Website Punch List looks at on a contractor's website (24 checks and phone speed), the four areas they fall under, and how the score out of 100 is worked out. It reads no website and needs no input.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_website_punch_list · Private data: get_website_punch_list · Public sink: get_website_punch_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_website_punch_list · Private data: get_website_punch_list · Public sink: get_website_punch_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
